author: Lethal_Aztec
quote: I will say it how it is, the game is absolute garbage, a huge disappointment for the fans of the franchise, and a disrespect for the most basic human intelligence, especially for men. They turned this game into a forced woke feminist homosexual product, where you have to play as a cuck simp without any options to preserve your dignity, your manhood or retaliate against the cynical traitorous disrespectful woman that you're forced to have a romantic relationship with, which is cheating on you and treating you like a fool from the very beginning of the game. You are also forced to have an homosexual night with another man as part of the narrative. The story is mediocre and the game is full of bugs, not worth buying at all, is by far the worst GTA ever made.
